Welcome to Ripley County Missouri
Welcome to Ripley County, Missouri
A place where history, community, and opportunity meet.
Nestled deep in the rugged, wooded hills of southern Missouri, Ripley County is a region rich in natural beauty, history, and small-town charm. Though officially organized in 1833, the county remained sparsely settled throughout the 19th century and did not take on its current boundaries until 1872. Its landscape—defined by the rolling hills of the Ozarks, abundant forests, and the clear waters of the Current River—remains one of its most defining features.
Today, Ripley County is more than just a scenic destination—it's a place to call home. Residents enjoy all the benefits of small-town living, including a close-knit community, a slower pace of life, and the safety and comfort of a rural lifestyle. But what truly sets Ripley County apart is the surprising range of services, resources, and opportunities available to those who live and work here.
Thriving Business Community
The Ripley County Chamber of Commerce, established in 1961, plays a vital role in supporting the local business landscape. With over 130 active members and a dedicated 15-member volunteer board, the Chamber fosters collaboration, economic development, and community pride. From professional development to tourism promotion and local government affairs, the Chamber serves as a powerful advocate and resource for businesses of all sizes.
A Place of Opportunity
Whether you're a lifelong resident, a newcomer, or a visitor considering making Ripley County your home, you’ll find a community that values growth, supports entrepreneurship, and welcomes innovation. Affordable living, excellent schools, local healthcare, and year-round recreational opportunities make Ripley County a compelling place to live, work, and raise a family.
Mission of the Chamber
The Ripley County Chamber of Commerce stands as the voice of business while supporting our members' success and taking a leadership role in the development and growth of Ripley County.
Discover Ripley County
From family-owned businesses and community events to outdoor adventures and historical landmarks, Ripley County offers something for everyone. Whether you're floating down the Current River, attending one of our annual festivals, or investing in your next business venture, you'll find that Ripley County is more than a location—it’s a lifestyle.
